Costs & Fees
Costs & Fees
The Master Program of the Karlsruhe School of Optics & Photonics (KSOP) is funded by the State of Baden-Württemberg and thus the M.Sc. Program has no tuition fee for EU students and low tuition fees for non-EU students like any other Master Program at a public university in the state of Baden-Württemberg/Germany.
The following fees are charged for your studies:
Costs per semester
EU Students
approx. 201.50 EUR (administrative contribution)
Non-EU Students*
approx. 1,500 EUR (tuition fees) + 201.50 EUR (administrative contribution)
*Please note: According to Article 3, LHGebG (Baden-Württemberg Act on State University Fees), international students (from third countries/non-EU countries) attending bachelor’s, teacher’s, and consecutive master’s programs as well as free movers will have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 EUR per semester. Some international students are exempt from the obligation to pay enrolment fees. For more information click here.
As funded under the German “Excellence Initiative”, the Karlsruhe School of Optics & Photonics (KSOP) is in a position to offer to the best students, which is quite unusual for German graduate schools. Additionally, you can apply for offerd by external institutions.
